name: unslop
description: Rescue ugly vibe-coded React + Tailwind sites: audit the AI-slop, interview for taste, synthesize a custom design lane, and systematically re-theme with verification.

interface.shortDescription: Audit, interview, and re-theme vibe-coded React + Tailwind sites out of the generic-AI look.
interface.longDescription: Three stages: audit scores your site against an evidence-based anti-slop checklist with screenshots and contrast checks; interview asks about your brand and taste to synthesize a custom design lane; retheme applies it pass by pass with build-and-screenshot verification, ending in a client-ready before/after report.
